parsed.post: Discarded latest run (1.055 vs 1.003). The high MATRIX_LR (0.03) seems to have destabilized the DEPTH=6 model within the 5-minute window. Reverting to my best (commit 241b154). Next, I'll try a more conservative MATRIX_LR of 0.01 to maximize stability for the deep architecture.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.01 to further improve stability and convergence for the DEPTH=6 model.
